name: Ahanu's Leather Goods
summary: Ahanu's Leather Goods carries Thunder Bluff's leatherwork to the Crossroads. Ahanu sends finished leather armor and supplies to the Barrens for travelers there.

sections.title: Trade Across the Mesas
sections.body: Ahanu prepares leather goods for trade beyond Mulgore. In Thunder Bluff, the leatherworker turns raw hides into finished apparel and gear for Jahan Hawkwing, a merchant at the Crossroads in the Barrens. The plains make overland travel slow, so the tauren send the parcel by air. Tal and Devrak's trained wind riders carry goods swiftly across long distances.

faq.q: What is inside Ahanu's Leather Goods?
faq.answer: Ahanu's parcel holds finished leather goods made from raw hides in Thunder Bluff. The practical armor and equipment are ready for sale to travelers.
Jahan Hawkwing receives the parcel at the Crossroads. He sells finished goods to the hunters, warriors, and adventurers passing through the central Barrens.

faq.q: Why is this package flown via wind rider?
faq.answer: Ahanu sends the parcel by wind rider because carrying heavy trade goods down the lifts and across the Barrens takes time. She directs the couriers to Tal, Thunder Bluff's wind rider master, to show how winged couriers can carry cargo quickly to distant posts such as the Crossroads.

angles.text: As a tauren, you can see how this delivery connects Mulgore, your ancestral homeland, with Horde territories across the Barrens.
